en: Ace Trainer Nohea: Anyone who wants the League has to get through me first. Just kidding. But battle me!
text: Antrenor As Nohea: Oricine vrea Liga trebuie să treacă mai întâi prin mine. Glumesc. Dar luptă cu mine!

en: Ace Trainer Nohea: Go on, then.
text: Antrenor As Nohea: Hai, mergi, atunci.

en: Ace Trainer Ailani: I've trained since Melemele. Every kahuna has seen my face.
text: Antrenor As Ailani: M-am antrenat încă de la Melemele. Fiecare kahuna mi-a văzut fața.

en: Ace Trainer Ailani: And now you've seen what I can do.
text: Antrenor As Ailani: Iar acum ai văzut ce pot.
